title.ko: 격식 vs 일상 · 구어체 축약 · 수동태 · 명사화
title.en: formal vs informal · contractions · passives · nominalisation

explain.ko: 격식체와 일상체는 상황과 대상에 따라 선택합니다. 일상체는 줄임말(I'm, can't), 구동사(find out, look into), 간단한 단어(get, ask for)를 쓰고, 격식체는 줄이지 않고 단어를 하나 하나 풀어 쓰며 수동태와 명사화(We decided → A decision was made), 더 공식적인 동사(receive, inform, request)를 씁니다. 정중한 요청은 Can you → Could you → Would you mind → I would be grateful if you could 순으로 격식이 높아집니다. 이메일에서는 Hi, Dear Sir or Madam, Yours sincerely처럼 인사와 맺음말도 어조에 맞춰야 합니다.
explain.en: Choose formal or informal English according to situation and reader. Informal English uses contractions (I'm, can't), phrasal verbs (find out, look into) and simple words (get, ask for). Formal English avoids contractions and prefers passives, nominalisation (We decided → A decision was made) and formal verbs (receive, inform, request). Polite requests rise in formality: Can you → Could you → Would you mind → I would be grateful if you could. In emails, greetings and endings also fit the tone: Hi, Dear Sir or Madam, Yours sincerely.

notes.en: Phrasal verbs are informal; replace them with one-word verbs: look into → investigate.
